What was wrong: (1) Building Systems revenue, a driver error: the crew chain started from Q2 FY27 397.5, which held only one month of NTI, so the base was ~30 too low; Q3 441.7 carries a full quarter. (2) Communications margin, mostly one-off: fuel cost 0.50pt (we had the Q2 0.35pt) and the inefficiency of accelerating work in the quarter (CFO), ~1.0pt below our 13.77%; we treat both as lapping in FY28, the no-recovery case is carded (-5.5%). (3) Building Systems margin 23.8% vs our 21.0%, a driver error on the mix of Power Solutions work; the FY28 band is carded. Not wrong: Communications revenue (1,615.0 vs 1,614.6) and the quarter-end backlog (5,420 vs 5,421); interest was 0.6 higher and other income 2.4 better (asset-sale gains). EPS beat ours by 0.22: +4.4 adjusted EBIT, +2.4 other income, -0.6 interest, tax 25.3% vs 26% (~+0.05). Blend legs: Communications customer leg 1,569 and peer leg 1,569 were 46 too low, the model leg 1,615 was right; Building Systems blend 435 was closer than the crew build 411.6 in the booked set, the agents' crew build 457 overshot by 15, the guide-implied ~415 was 27 low.

What moved (research target (12m) 272.14 -> 274.67, +0.9%): Communications rebuilt by program from the Q3 NTM backlog 5,421 (FY28 6,350.2 vs 6,616.6 before; backlog -13.1, margin -3.3); Building Systems rebuilt from Q3 441.7 with crews +20% FY28 and +15% after (FY28 2,022.4 after the moratorium vs 1,784.5 before; +14.7); buybacks priced at $179.01 under the new $200M authorization (+7.9); supplier finance debt-like 252.9 of 524.0 (-1.7); net debt 2,616.0, the Q3 roll and DY's own interest on the SOFR curve (-2.5); growth term (+0.3). Guide: Q4 revenue 1.63-1.70B (record-adjusted 1,764.7, ours 1,749.6), adjusted EPS 2.48-2.78 (ours 2.97); FY27 7.66-7.73B (ours 7,776.6), a cross-check only.

Logged news moves: comms_ntm_backlog FY2028 -4.5% RESIZED: built from the programs the CEO named (FTTH -10%, long-haul/DCI +300, wireless +150, copper +75), the FY28 quarter ends sit 4.5-6.2% below the previous path and FY29 7-9% below, with Communications FY28 revenue 6,350.2 inside the 6,261-6,381 the outlook implies. bs_share FY2028 +0.05pt TAKEN AND EXCEEDED: the screen assumed the old 15% chain; rebuilding from the Q3 actual with a full quarter of NTI and crews +20% lifts FY28 Building Systems to 2,111 before the moratorium haircut (2,022.4 after) vs 1,784.5 before.
